item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】PACK - MEGA PACK - No Rap Versions/Solo Edits, Vol. 4 (FLAC)
item.description:
Here comes another no rap versions/solo edits pack. Enjoy!

All of them are non-official and made by me. (Except 9, but I re-edited it, so it's still not official)

Track 4, 5, 13, 14 and 15 were made upon @pwner14 's request. If you have other no rap version/solo edit requests please don't hesitate to contact me in DMs.

Please don't share them outside sharemania.

Previous volumes: Vol.1 Vol.2 Vol.3
